## Summary
Francis Anto is a full stack developer and AI engineer based in Thrissur, Kerala. He builds web applications with React, Python, MongoDB, and SQL, with interests in blockchain technologies, multimodal AI systems, and AI system security.

## Key Projects
- **Prompt Vulnerability & Token Analyzer**
  - Repository: https://github.com/francisanto/backendprompt
  - Final year engineering research and backend system inspecting LLM prompts to detect security vulnerabilities (prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage) while benchmarking token efficiency, latency, and cost.
- **Concordia**
  - Repository: https://github.com/francisanto/coincordia
  - Collaborative decentralized platform for goal tracking, team coordination, and shared fund management on opBNB Testnet with MetaMask. Recognized in BNB Hack Builders Spotlight.
- **InANOut**
  - Repository: https://github.com/francisanto/inanout
  - Live Demo: https://inanout.lovable.app/
  - Fund management and expense coordination platform with group lending/borrowing tracking and financial analytics.
- **PA System Classifier**
  - Repository: https://github.com/francisanto/CaptaNet
  - Real-time voice announcement classification system for emergency alerts and public announcements using WhisperX, deployed via Linux hostapd hotspot and captive portal.
- **Emotion & Relationship Classifier**
  - Repository: https://github.com/francisanto/Emotion_detection
  - BERT-based NLP models and speech features to classify human emotions and relationship patterns from chat conversations with MySQL storage.
- **Repa**
  - Repository: https://github.com/francisanto/Repa
  - Class management platform featuring student verification, Razorpay payments, and OCR timetable extraction.
